title: Re: Strike at Storeroom 7B
description: Re: Strike at Storeroom 7B — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Wally Wanka

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 7B and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Wally Wanka

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 7B and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

You have single-handedly crippled Abaddon's ability to manufacture his Abysmal Candy line and now he is close to going bankrupt and getting evicted from The Embercore Path. But now is not the time to let off! We must continue to cause devastation before he regains his sugar-coated supremacy over the dungeon!

Double-time it down to Storeroom 7B and level Abaddon's Candy Fabricators there. If he is able to regain his foothold there then it is only a matter of time before we lose all the momentum you have been working so hard to establish. Then, once the Candy Fabricators are destroyed, return to me, Wally Wanka, here in The Embercore Portal.

Turn-in:

Wonderful! You've done it haven't you? Do you want to do it again?

Objectives:

  • Candy Fabricators

Client level range: 50–100
